correctness.rationale: The proof splits both adjacency maps over an algebraic closure at roots of the shift polynomial. Only nontrivial cube roots can support zero eigenvalues; their multiplicity gives 2 J2 or 4 Jh for prisms, versus 4 J1 or 2 J2h for Möbius ladders. Kernel powers give exact entry populations via Fitting. Independently 1,250 matrix-power rank comparisons and 174,720 exhaustively classified binary configurations support the formulas; experiments do not prove all n or Q.

value.rationale: Cyclic prisms and Möbius ladders are canonical cubic graph pairs differing by a twist. Their binary recurrent-state counts coincide at each circumference, yet the complete transient Jordan partitions and sharp settling clocks reverse in odd cases and double in even cases. The statement is an infinite-family dynamical classification and provides exact state-population distributions useful to graph automata and finite-field spectral analysis, not a one-off rank computation.
